visual.general_description: Color microscopy field of a stained blood film: many round, pale pinkish-gray red-cell profiles with central pale areas on a lilac-gray granular background, with four white arrows marking individual cells.
visual.detailed_description: The field is filled with round cells of similar size, each with a paler centre, on a pale lilac-gray speckled background. Four white arrows with arrowheads mark four separate cells: one in the upper middle of the field pointing up and to the left, one right of centre pointing left, one in the lower middle pointing downward, and one near the bottom pointing toward a cell at the lower edge. The marked cells contain small dark purple dots or ring-like inclusions; the cell indicated by the lower-middle arrow holds several small ring-shaped inclusions. Several small dark purple bodies and one star-shaped purple object lie between or beside cells without arrows. No panel letters, scale bar, magnification, stain name, patient text, date or other printed text is visible.
